description: This Java class defines the configuration for SNMP device transport, including fields for host, port, protocol version, and SNMP v3 security parameters. It includes validation logic to ensure configuration correctness.

classes.name: SnmpDeviceTransportConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration class for SNMP device transport, supporting SNMP v1, v2c, and v3 with validation logic.

methods.name: SnmpDeviceTransportConfiguration
methods.description: Default constructor initializing host, port, protocol version, and community string.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the configuration, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
